parts.name: Form
parts.description: A native `<form>` with `novalidate`. On submit it validates every enabled Field inside, prevents the submit and focuses the first invalid field when one fails, and shows errors passed in by field name.

props.name: validationMode
props.description: When the Fields inside validate, unless a FieldRoot sets its own: `"onSubmit"` (on submit, then on every change), `"onBlur"` or `"onChange"`. A submit always validates every field.

props.name: errors
props.description: Errors to show, keyed by field name: a message or a list of messages each. An entry is hidden once its field's value changes, until `errors` changes again. Compared by content, so set it to `{}` when a submit starts.

props.name: onFormSubmit
props.description: Called on a valid submit with the values of the enabled, named Fields, keyed by name. The native submission is then prevented.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the submit event on a valid submit, before `onFormSubmit`. Without `onFormSubmit`, the native submission goes ahead unless this prevents it.
